# Ataur Agency

> Ataur Agency is a Jamshedpur, Jharkhand-based digital agency specializing in 
AI automation (n8n workflows, WhatsApp lead-follow-up systems), MERN/Next.js 
web development, and SEO/GEO/AEO strategy for Indian businesses, with a strong 
focus on the hospitality and travel sector.

## Core Services
- AI Automation & n8n Workflow Development
- MERN Stack / Next.js Website Development
- SEO, GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) & AEO Strategy
- Cybersecurity Audits & VAPT
- Google Business Profile & Local SEO Optimization

## Key Pages

- Projects/Case Studies: https://atauragency.in/projects

- Contact: https://atauragency.in/contact

## Notable Work
- Hotel UP Wala — Hotel Booking & listing platform built on Next.js, increasing direct bookings by 40% for 50+ local hotels.
- MyNextTrip — Premium Luxury Travel Booking Portal resulting in over 1.5 million travelers choosing the platform for luxury escapes.
- Invest Secure — Professional Income Investment & Wealth Management Platform that significantly increased user engagement and capital investments.
